thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — gpu-queue growth in europe-west1, autoscaler failing to provision new GPUs (QUOTA_EXCEEDED errors). Root cause unknown yet. Investigating.

mike: Ack. I’m on call. grabbing logs now.

sara: I see queued tasks climbing from 200 -> 1800 over the last 12m in the eu pool. Autoscaler kept retrying but GCP returned quota errors around 12:02 UTC.

elena: Can you paste the exact error from the autoscaler logs?

mike: pasted snippet from infra logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:01:58Z autoscaler: request to compute.googleapis.com/projects/redwood/regions/europe-west1/instances -> error: quotaExceeded
Code: 403
Message: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 123456789 in region europe-west1.
```

liz_cs: Customer impact: two mid-market customers on Dedicated pools reported timeouts ~12:05. We have 3 support tickets and one escalation from an enterprise customer. They’re asking for ETA.

mike: quick assessment: hosted API traffic for small customers is degraded (slightly higher latency), dedicated tenants on eu-west1 hitting allocation failures. We need immediate mitigation for customer-facing queues.

platform-bot: Note: fallback policy 'region-fallback' available — will reroute requests to eu-west4 if enabled. Current config: enabled=false for some dedicated routes.

sara: Temporary mitigations I can do now:
- enable region-fallback for non-sensitive routes
- scale down batch sizes on large requests to reduce GPU memory pressure
- release any unused warm pools and free GPUs if held by lower-priority jobs

mike: Do that. Prioritize customers with SLAs. Which customers to move first? liz_cs can coordinate.

liz_cs: Move enterprise customer A first (has 99.9 SLA), then two mid-market. I'll DM their CSMs and update tickets.

elena: Running gcloud check to confirm quota values:
```
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1 --project=redwood
# looking at quotas -> GPUs: limit=24, usage=24
```

mike: So we’re at the hard quota limit in region. GCP is denying new GPU attach. That explains the autoscaler retries.

ryan: If quotas are hard-capped we need either temporary reroute or request quota increase. Quota increases take hours. For immediate, reroute traffic + enable fallback models.

sara: Enabling fallback now for non-dedicated hosted routes: `PATCH /config/fallbacks` -> set europe->eu-west4 = true. Doing it.

platform-bot: Config change applied: region-fallback enabled for hosted routes.

mike: Start draining new dedicated allocations in eu-west1 and mark new requests as 'try-other-region' at router. Add a 503->302 style client header to prompt retry to eu-west4 for our SDKs.

elena: Executing drain: `kubectl annotate pool/eu-west1-dedicated draining=true` and router rule updated.

liz_cs: Notifying customer A that we are rerouting and applying a temporary mitigation. Message: "We're rerouting compute to eu-west4 while we work with GCP to resolve region quota. Minimal impact expected but you may see a short increase in latency."

mike: Also scaling down large batch concurrency lanes to reduce tokens per GPU: `autoscale.conf.max_batch_tokens: 4096 -> 2048` applied to eu pools.

sara: Good. Monitoring queue now. If queue stabilizes under 300 in 10m, we consider this partial mitigation successful.

platform-bot: Alert: queue_depth(eu)=1429 -> 710 -> 285 (10m window). Trend: improving.

mike: Nice. Next steps:
- open GCP quota increase request and mark P1 (sara)
- prepare playbook for moving reserved capacity tenants if GA ticket requires it (elena)
- customer comms template ready (liz)
- hand off to night on-call (ryan) at 20:00 UTC for monitoring and follow-up

sara: GCP support case created - case# 987654321. Requesting emergency quota bump for europe-west1 GPUs. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/987654321

elena: Documenting runbook changes: adding 'check-region-quota' earlier in autoscaler retry policy and adding immediate fallback toggle for dedicated routes.

liz_cs: Customer A updated in ticket. They acknowledged and will monitor. Two mid-market customers also pinged. No escalations so far.

mike: Handing over to ryan for overnight monitoring. I’ll continue to follow as backup. ryan, I stamped this as incident-bridge: true and pinned the GCP case number in the incident tracker.

ryan: Ack — I have the bridge. Will watch queue + support thread. If queue > 600 for > 15m or new 403s appear, page infra oncall.

platform-bot: Incident note appended: mitigation reroute -> eu-west4 applied; autoscaler batch cap reduced; GCP case 987654321 opened.

mike: Thanks everyone. Postmortem owners: sara (root cause/infra), elena (runbook changes), liz_cs (customer comms). I’ll create the incident doc after stabilization. :thumbsup:
__notes: This JSON represents a single Slack thread. Fields are strings or list of strings as required.
